COMMAND: curl -sS -m 180 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8800/api/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"reply with the single word ok"}' -o /tmp/sym-smoke-chat.out -w '%{http_code}' > /tmp/sym-smoke-chat.code; python3 -c "import sys;c=open('/tmp/sym-smoke-chat.code').read().strip();b=open('/tmp/sym-smoke-chat.out',errors='replace').read();assert c=='200', f'HTTP {c}';assert len(b.strip())>0, 'empty completion';print(f'PASS http={c} bytes={len(b)}')"
EXPECTED_RESULT: HTTP 200 AND a non-empty generated completion. Both asserted; an empty 200 fails.

COMMAND: curl -sS -m 600 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8800/api/image -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"a plain grey square","width":512,"height":512}' -o /tmp/sym-smoke-image.json -w '%{http_code}' > /tmp/sym-smoke-image.code; python3 -c "import json,os,glob;c=open('/tmp/sym-smoke-image.code').read().strip();assert c=='200', f'HTTP {c}';d=json.load(open('/tmp/sym-smoke-image.json'));u=d.get('url') or d.get('image') or '';assert u, f'no url in response: {list(d)}';n=os.path.basename(u.split('?')[0]);hits=glob.glob('backend/output/**/'+n, recursive=True);assert hits, f'{n} not on disk';sig=open(hits[0],'rb').read(8);assert sig[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n', 'not a PNG';print(f'PASS http={c} png={hits[0]}')"
EXPECTED_RESULT: HTTP 200, a url in the body, the file present on disk, and its first 8 bytes are the PNG signature. Not merely a 200.

COMMAND: curl -sS -m 30 http://127.0.0.1:8800/local/coder/status | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);assert d.get('ok') is True, d.get('ok');assert d.get('allow_remote') is False, d.get('allow_remote');assert d.get('denied_segments'), 'denied_segments empty';print('PASS ok=True allow_remote=False')"
EXPECTED_RESULT: ok == true AND allow_remote == false AND a populated denied_segments list. Coder serves NO /api route by design -- its endpoints are /local/* behind a peer-address check, because ops/Caddyfile proxies /api/* to the public internet.
